title: Tournament of Champions
seo_title: Bass Pro Tournament of Champions in Springfield, MO
description: The Bass Pro Tournament of Champions is a sports event held at Great Southern Bank Arena, with sessions over three days. It runs January 14-16, 2027, with events on Thursday and Friday at 4:00 PM and Saturday at 2:00 PM, at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO. Ticketing information will be announced soon.
